title: Metroid Prime: Metroid Quarantine
alt: A dark cavern lit by great mushrooms that give a blue-green light, each with a tall pale stem and a wide cap. Creatures like jellyfish float in the air: each is a clear green bell with three red balls inside it and curved fangs under it. The greatest of them, in the middle, comes down with its fangs wide. Others drift behind it, and far ones are only green lights with a red point. At the left, on a ledge, a small figure in orange armour with a red helmet and a green visor stands with feet apart and aims a cannon up. A line of pale blue light goes from the cannon to one creature, which is white with ice. In the floor at the right a pool of bright blue cracks like lightning.
summary: A painting of Samus and the Metroids in the Phazon Mines from Metroid Prime in {strokes} brush strokes, with a playback of each stroke.
text: This is Metroid Prime, by Retro Studios. Deep in the Phazon Mines the Space Pirates kept Metroids in a cavern, and the Metroids are loose. A Metroid floats in the air, takes hold of a living thing with its fangs, and drinks its life.

Cold is the one thing that stops them. So Samus Aran fires the Ice Beam, and one Metroid is in ice. The blue light in the floor is Phazon, the poison that came to this world from the sky. The painting has {strokes} brush strokes.
